lines.speaker: Jason
lines.text: Hale. Jason Hale. A detective's ID, half eaten by the fire.
A corridor. Footsteps behind you, fast. You start to turn.
A blurred figure. No face. A hand raised high, holding something heavy.
Then the floor, rushing up. Then nothing.

after.speaker: Jason
after.text: Someone did this to me. And left me here to die.

lines.text: A man by the candles. Tall, dark coat, one hand wrapped in a bandage. He goes very still when he sees you.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: ...You. You're alive.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Easy. You're hurt. Do you... remember anything? Where you are? Who you are?

lines.speaker: Jason
lines.text: My name. Jason Hale. That's all I've got.
Something in his shoulders loosens.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Good. I mean, that's... not good. I'm Daniel. Daniel Mercer. Stay close. I'll get us out of here.

lines.speaker: Jason
lines.text: Your hand.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: This? Cut it on a door. It's nothing.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: They don't like the light. Or the candles. Use that.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: The east wing door's locked. If there's a key, it's in the library, through the west door. Go on. I'll watch the door.

MISSING PERSON. Emily Carter, age 16. Last seen near the old Ashgrove estate.
Status: CLOSED, UNSOLVED. No evidence of foul play.
In the margin, in handwriting you somehow know is yours: "She's not the first. They're all here."

after.speaker: Jason
after.text: My handwriting. I worked this case.

lines.text: A child's drawing in crayon. A little girl holding hands with a tall man. Around them, grey figures with no faces.
The figures are all smiling at her.

after.speaker: Jason
after.text: ...Why does this make my chest hurt?

lines.text: The lock gives. Through the high window, the moon is changing. The cold blue bleeds slowly into orange.
Somewhere below, the chanting swells.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: After you.
